The unrestricted rotational-work expression used a vector angle differential without specifying its relation to angular velocity. Replace it with moment–angular-velocity power and the fixed-axis special case, require power-conjugate generalized moments for Euler rates, and distinguish hand work from net work and one impulse from the net external momentum balance.

Define resolved mechanical storage, nonconservative boundary work, internal chemical/actuator conversion and dissipation, retaining separate impact balances and preventing ambiguous gravity/shaft double counting.

The existing equation-term caveat was correct but did not explain why generalized component work is not endpoint force work or an independent kinetic-energy supply. Derive the residual-power identity and velocity-bias/mass-matrix-rate cancellation under explicit ideal-model assumptions.

Keep masked impulse separate from full-interval generalized work; valid duration is not an error bound.

The reference-point invariance statement lacked rigid-body and observer conditions, and joint angular velocity was unspecified. Supply the paired wrench/velocity transformation, separate observer changes and deformation/contact motion, and use relative joint angular velocity for net joint power while retaining absolute segment flows.

The drift/control and cited-study discussion needed clearer inference limits. Separate same-state attribution from trajectory interventions and prescribed kinematic sweeps from forward simulations; state the human study populations/designs and distinguish energy consistency from independent model validation.
